findings.payer: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama
findings.title: BCBS AL medical policy portal (Itiliti Health 'My Policies')
findings.note: Plan requires precert for knee arthroplasty and lumbar spinal fusion (provider precert list) and publishes policies on the public Itiliti portal, but the portal is a JavaScript-only React app that returns an empty shell to non-browser fetches; criteria text could not be retrieved.

Vendor: MCG.

findings.payer: Arkansas Blue Cross and Blue Shield
findings.title: Coverage Policy search (Coverage Policy Manual)
findings.note: No coverage policy for open lumbar fusion (22612). Related policy 2011007 'Minimally Invasive Lumbar Interbody Fusion' lists only 22558/22585/22586/22630/22632 and since April 2026 simply requires a 'recommended' InterQual determination. Plan states it uses InterQual criteria for services without a coverage policy. Vendor: InterQual.
